description: Seyed Ali Seyed-Bouzari at Graz University of Technology publishes six MATLAB modelling and optimisation packages supporting doctoral research on variable-speed generator design and grid resilience. They cover analytic design and modelling, controllability analysis and multi-objective optimisation of doubly-fed induction machines for wind turbines and electrically excited synchronous machines for large pumped-storage plants. Users supply physical, geometric and operating constraints. The software generates feasible machine designs, calculates controllability measures and identifies Pareto-optimal combinations of electromagnetic and controllability performance. The implementation was developed and tested with MATLAB R2023a; the source recommends that release or a compatible newer version. A public RAR archive is available without a stated charge under the MIT licence. These are general machine-design models with no fixed geographic coverage or calendar period. Their assumptions and derivations depend on the accompanying dissertation. The catalogue has not executed the code or independently verified the claimed performance. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
